 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOURENDRA PANDEY
ORAL ORDER 2 05-02-2026 Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. The present application has been filed for quashing the order dated 17.10.2022 passed by learned J.M. 1st Class, Munger in Complaint Case No.960C of 2022, CIS No. 960 of 2022 whereby cognizance has been taken against him under Section(s) 498A and 354 of the I.P.C.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are the in-laws of O.P.No.2 and general and omnibus allegations have been levelled against them that too with false Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.4907 of 2025(2) dt.05-02-2026 and concocted story.

4. In view of the aforesaid submissions, let notice be issued to O.P. No. 2 through ordinary post as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week from today.
